caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a candlestick holder or an oil lamp, rendered in shades of gray pencil or graphite on a plain, off-white background. The object has a round, slightly raised base with a smooth edge, supporting a slender, curving stem that expands at the midpoint into a bulbous section before narrowing again. Attached to the upper part of the stem on one side is a curved handle. The top section features a cylindrical container with two ringed bands near its base and top, finished with a tapered spout or nozzle extending upwards. The item is centered within a bordered rectangular frame, with a smaller inset sketch of the same object located in the upper right corner, outlining its form with simple, lighter lines. There are no other objects, patterns, or colors present in the composition.
title: Whale Oil Lamp
